mtp0.conclusion: Under the recorded TP4/DCP1 conditions, the packaged runtime sustains 53.80, 171.30, and 283.05 tok/s at C1, C4, and C8, plus 3253 tok/s for an uncached 8192-token prefill.

mtp3.conclusion: MTP3 fits the 65536-token profile at GMU 0.98 and executes target verification plus all three draft forwards through CUDA graphs.

teacher_forced_quality.conditions: Paired 2047-position full-vocabulary comparison against one BF16 teacher, FP8 KV cache, and three repeats per candidate
teacher_forced_quality.conclusion: The BF16-source merged-K6 and separate-shared-K6 run distributions overlap; the test did not measure a quality regression from merged runtime K6 encoding.
teacher_forced_quality.limitation: The paired quality test used FP8 KV. The r34 Compose profile uses NVFP4 DS-MLA KV, so the numbers do not isolate the quality effect of that cache format.
